question: Can the fixed-h3 sufficient descriptors U_i and J_i identified by S3-D3 be uniquely recovered from the existing retained hydraulic state and remain exact when the demand-dependent Feddes threshold h3 changes, or does exact forcing-portable feedback require a richer root-weighted within-layer distribution object?

existing_state_recoverability.rule: If existing retained state uniquely determined U_i and J_i, then by the S3-D3 exact identity it would uniquely determine the fixed-h3 Feddes functional.
existing_state_recoverability.evidence: C6P already supplies matched-storage and matched-storage-plus-geometric-first-moment fine profiles with different fixed-h3 Feddes uptake.
existing_state_recoverability.interpretation: Use logical composition only; do not create new response data.

moving_threshold_counterexample.conditions: Choose any h4 < h3_b < h3_a. Construct two root-weighted head distributions with identical DeltaF, U(h3_a) and J(h3_a), but different mass placement around h3_b.

forcing_portable_exact_object.interpretation: The full root-weighted pressure-head measure, or an equivalent threshold-queryable cumulative representation, is sufficient for arbitrary h3 without storing the response itself.

preregistered_interpretation.EXISTING_STATE_NOT_EXACTLY_RECOVERABLE: C6P non-uniqueness plus S3-D3 sufficiency implies U/J are not unique functions of existing storage state; the same conclusion holds for storage plus the tested geometric first moment.
preregistered_interpretation.FORCING_PORTABLE_EXACT_OBJECT_IS_DISTRIB: Exact arbitrary-h3 evaluation is provided by the root-weighted head measure/cumulative threshold-query object; no finite low-dimensional minimality theorem is claimed.
preregistered_interpretation.DYNAMIC_ROOT_STATE_NOT_SELECTED: A distributional exact object is not automatically an admissible reduced state or closure.

boundaries: No new hydraulic or root-specific propagated state.
No assumption that a finite set of moments is universally impossible beyond the tested/derived claim boundary.
next_if_confirmed: Close the exactness branch: a compact exact fixed-h3 response coordinate exists, but no forcing-portable exact low-dimensional state has been established. Any finite approximate root-information surrogate must be purpose/tolerance qualified before dynamic admission.
